title: Single-cell multiomics profiling reveals tumour microenvironment landscape and sex-specific immune-suppressive feature in male breast cancer.
snippet: Male breast cancer (MBC) represents a small proportion of all breast cancer (BC) cases, yet it is characterized by a higher rate of lymph node metastasis and poorer prognosis compared to female breast cancer (FBC).
